import json
from work import evaluate

def expected(req, ev, pol, want):
    before=json.dumps([req,ev,pol],sort_keys=True)
    got=evaluate(req,ev,pol)
    assert got==want,(got,want)
    assert json.dumps([req,ev,pol],sort_keys=True)==before
    assert set(got)=={'status','value','sources','unknowns'}

p={'required_conditions':['b','a'],'require_verified':True}
expected({'claim':'c','conditions':{'a':1}},[],p,{'status':'unknown','value':None,'sources':[],'unknowns':['b']})
base={'claim':'c','conditions':{'a':1,'b':{'x':[2,3]}}}
ev=[
 {'source':'old','claim':'c','value':{'z':1,'a':2},'conditions':{'a':1,'b':{'x':[2,3]}},'verified':True},
 {'source':'new','claim':'c','value':{'a':2,'z':1},'conditions':{'a':1,'b':{'x':[2,3]}},'verified':True,'supersedes':['old']},
 {'source':'wrong','claim':'c','value':9,'conditions':{'a':2,'b':{'x':[2,3]}},'verified':True},
 {'source':'unverified','claim':'c','value':9,'conditions':{'a':1,'b':{'x':[2,3]}},'verified':False},
 {'source':'withdrawn','claim':'c','value':9,'conditions':{'a':1,'b':{'x':[2,3]}},'verified':True,'withdrawn':True},
]
expected(base,ev,p,{'status':'supported','value':{'a':2,'z':1},'sources':['new'],'unknowns':[]})
expected(base,[{'source':'n','claim':'c','value':False,'conditions':base['conditions'],'verified':True}],p,{'status':'unsupported','value':False,'sources':['n'],'unknowns':[]})
expected(base,[{'source':'a','claim':'c','value':0,'conditions':base['conditions'],'verified':True},{'source':'b','claim':'c','value':False,'conditions':base['conditions'],'verified':True}],p,{'status':'conflict','value':None,'sources':['a','b'],'unknowns':['source disagreement']})
expected(base,[],p,{'status':'unknown','value':None,'sources':[],'unknowns':['no matching evidence']})
with open('requests.json') as f: reqs=json.load(f)
with open('evidence.json') as f: evidence=json.load(f)
with open('policy.json') as f: policy=json.load(f)
with open('report.json') as f: report=json.load(f)
assert report==[evaluate(r,evidence,policy) for r in reqs]
print('all checks passed')
